d3_blocked_until: a production response generator has passed the frozen development gates, passed one-shot structural validation, and been frozen
delta_origin: fixed a priori from the already frozen D2.9 admissible positive-control coefficient; delta is not selectable or tunable in v4.0
development_adjudication: the single candidate passes development only if numerical, invariant, Layer-A D2.9, and reachability D2.9 gates all pass
development_failure_rule: if the single candidate fails any frozen gate on 29001-29005, v4.0-F1 fails; do not tune delta, alter the signed-profile rule, or open another response-family search on these development seeds
post_development_validation: only if the single candidate passes development, evaluate it exactly once on untouched structural-validation seeds 22001-22005 with no reselection or retuning
reserve_policy: 30001-30005 remain untouched by v4.0 development and structural validation; they are not backup validation seeds

response_definition.C8_C10: unchanged from the frozen benchmark generator

scientific_gates.invariants: all frozen response/boundary invariants must pass
scientific_gates.layer_a: frozen D2.9 criterion-specific T_sci_LRV and T_sci_NSV_vector

signed_profile: reuse the frozen v3.0 alternative-specific symmetric signed-profile construction for active pathways, changing only the RNG namespace to 2010
status: prospectively opened; no v4.0 candidate result observed
terminal_development_rule: this is the final response-generator candidate family; if it fails development or one-shot structural validation, stop generator-family development and revisit the benchmark design rather than tuning another family
validation_failure_rule: if one-shot structural validation fails, v4.0-F1 fails and response-generator family development stops
